# Fungi and parasites

> *How do eukaryotic microbes differ from bacteria, and why does that make them harder to target?*

::: {.callout-note}
## In preparation
This unit is planned but not yet written. The outline below shows what it will cover.
:::

## Planned content

- Yeasts versus moulds, and fungi that switch between the two
- Protozoa versus helminths
- Life cycles and hosts: definitive, intermediate and incidental
- Why eukaryotic microbes offer few unique targets

## Planned interactives

- Side-by-side comparison of yeast and mould
- Image sorter: protozoan or helminth?

**Links to other teaching:** Selective toxicity.
